info.title: Cadmus WebSocket and SSE
info.description: Generated from @cadmus/contract. /ws carries ClientToServer commands and ServerToClient frames (command.result and events). /events is Server-Sent Events whose data field is a ServerEvent. command.result is not sent on /events. A `: connected` comment is a heartbeat.

events.description: SSE. Each data field is a JSON ServerEvent. Auth matches /ws (query token and session cookie are accepted). This is not /api.

payload.description: Tool call invocation details.

TurnToolCallEvent.description: Event notification that the model has requested execution of an agent tool.

type.description: Event type identifier for tool call results.

chatKey.description: Chat session routing key.

toolCallId.description: Correlation identifier matching the originating toolCallId.

toolName.description: Name of the tool that finished executing.

payload.description: Tool execution result details.

TurnToolResultEvent.description: Event notification providing the result or error produced by an agent tool.
